include_regex:
(?:
        federated\s+(?:learn|training|train|machine\s+learning|ml|model)
      | federal\s+learn
      | federation\s+learn
      | \bfedavg\b
      | \bfedprox\b
      | \bfedsgd\b
      | hierarchical\s+federated
      | vertical\s+federated
      | horizontal\s+federated
      | federated\s+edge\s+learn
      | 연합\s*학습
    )
notes: federal learn / federation learn included (common CN mistranslation of 联邦学习)
MEC federation / neutral host excluded (not federated learning)
title_hit=1 means the include regex matched the title
fetched/ and pse/ are copies of matching files only; missing sidecar is not an error
